messages.text: Tell me a little about the school

Ting-A-Ling Schools is located right here in Meerensee, Richards Bay. We run two schools — a Pre-Primary School (ages 2–6) with play-based learning and school readiness programmes, and a Special Needs School (ages 3–12) offering individualised care and therapy support. Both schools focus on small class sizes and a nurturing environment 😊

Is there anything specific you'd like to know about either school?
Does the SN have therapy?

Yes, the Special Needs School offers therapy support for the learners, including occupational therapy. For more specific information about the therapy programmes, feel free to contact the school office.
How much are the u uniforms?
Uniforms are R150 per shirt and R450 per tracksuit. If you need the full uniform list and pricelist, you're welcome to pop into the office during school hours 😊
Thank you
You're most welcome! 😊 If you have any questions about Ting-A-Ling Schools — fees, enrolment, hours, or anything else — feel free to ask.
